# TlsClient

**Class** · `ironwood.net.tls.TlsClient`

```java
public final class TlsClient implements Closeable
```

**Implements:** [`Closeable`](../../io/Closeable.md)

Verified, single-connection blocking TLS 1.2/1.3 client. Verifies the certificate chain,
validity, server purpose and DNS or IP identity. DNS identities send SNI; numeric identities
check IP subject alternative names without SNI. Uses pinned bundled roots or an explicit
replacement PEM file, not ambient system trust. There is no verification bypass, revocation
checking, session resumption or early data.


Configuration inputs are copied. Stream views borrow this client and must not be freed
separately. Close the client before freeing it: close releases TLS and TCP resources, while
destruction only reclaims the managed graph. Closing either stream closes the client. Connection
history remains true after closure.


Connect, read and write use separate per-operation deadline budgets. Zero disables a
deadline. Synchronous DNS cannot be interrupted, but its elapsed time is charged when it
returns. A failed connection attempt, record timeout or fatal record error closes the client;
create a new client to retry.


Retained TLS operations require the matching optional Ironwood TLS SDK at final link. This
API uses native transports and bypasses global socket factories.

## Methods

<a name="member-connect-28-String-2c-int-2c-int-29-"></a>

### `connect(String,int,int)`

```java
public void connect(String host, int port, int timeout) throws IOException
```

Connects and completes a verified handshake using the host as peer identity. Direct
connections resolve synchronously; proxies receive the unresolved destination. SOCKS4
callers must instead supply a resolved IPv4 endpoint to the endpoint overload. The deadline
covers trust setup, elapsed DNS time, transport connection, proxy negotiation and handshake.
Failures after argument/state validation close the client.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `host` | a nonempty ASCII DNS name without a trailing dot, or numeric IP identity; copied as needed |
| `port` | the destination port from 1 through 65535 |
| `timeout` | the total connect budget in milliseconds; zero means no deadline |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`NullPointerException`](../../lang/NullPointerException.md) | if a required identity or endpoint is null |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](../../lang/IllegalArgumentException.md) | if timeout is negative, the port is invalid, or the identity is not accepted ASCII DNS/IP syntax |
| [`SocketTimeoutException`](../SocketTimeoutException.md) | if the connection deadline expires |
| [`SocketException`](../SocketException.md) | if already connected or closed, or TLS trust, peer verification or protocol setup fails |
| [`IOException`](../../io/IOException.md) | if resolution, TCP connection or proxy negotiation fails |

<a name="member-connect-28-InetSocketAddress-2c-String-2c-int-29-"></a>

### `connect(InetSocketAddress,String,int)`

```java
public void connect(InetSocketAddress endpoint, String peerIdentity, int timeout) throws IOException
```

Connects to the supplied route and verifies an independently supplied peer identity. The
endpoint is borrowed only for this call. A direct route requires a resolved endpoint; SOCKS4
also requires IPv4. The deadline covers trust setup, transport, proxy negotiation and
handshake. Failures after argument/state validation close the client.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | the destination route with a nonzero port |
| `peerIdentity` | a nonempty ASCII DNS name without a trailing dot, or numeric IP identity to verify |
| `timeout` | the total connect budget in milliseconds; zero means no deadline |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`NullPointerException`](../../lang/NullPointerException.md) | if a required identity or endpoint is null |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](../../lang/IllegalArgumentException.md) | if timeout is negative, the port is invalid, or the identity is not accepted ASCII DNS/IP syntax |
| [`SocketTimeoutException`](../SocketTimeoutException.md) | if the connection deadline expires |
| [`SocketException`](../SocketException.md) | if already connected or closed, or TLS trust, peer verification or protocol setup fails |
| [`IOException`](../../io/IOException.md) | if resolution, TCP connection or proxy negotiation fails |

### `setReadTimeout(int)`

```java
public void setReadTimeout(int timeout)
```

Sets the deadline budget for each subsequent read operation. Each read starts a new budget,
including readiness retries. A timeout closes the connection. This setting can be changed
before or after connect.

**Parameters**

| `timeout` | nonnegative milliseconds; zero disables the deadline |

<a name="member-getInputStream-28--29-"></a>

### `getInputStream()`

```java
public InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException
```

Returns a cached input view borrowing this client. Do not free it separately or use it after
freeing the client. Reads borrow caller buffers only for the call; zero-length reads perform
no native I/O. Clean TLS shutdown produces EOF; transport truncation is an error. The read
timeout or a fatal record error closes the client. available() reports already decrypted
bytes; closing the view closes the client.

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`SocketException`](../SocketException.md) | if this client is unconnected or closed |

**Returns**

the stable borrowed input stream

<a name="member-getOutputStream-28--29-"></a>

### `getOutputStream()`

```java
public OutputStream getOutputStream() throws IOException
```

Returns a cached output view borrowing this client. Do not free it separately or use it
after freeing the client. Writes borrow caller buffers only for the call; zero-length writes
perform no native I/O. Each write has one configured deadline across retries. A timeout or
fatal record error closes the client and may follow partial delivery. Closing the view
closes the client.

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`SocketException`](../SocketException.md) | if this client is unconnected or closed |

**Returns**

the stable borrowed output stream

<a name="member-close-28--29-"></a>

### `close()`

```java
@Override
public void close() throws IOException
```

Closes the client idempotently, attempts one nonblocking TLS close notification, then
releases native TLS state and closes TCP. Does not wait for the peer notification or
guarantee delivery on a blocked transport. Managed storage and borrowed views remain
allocated until the client is freed. Resources are still released when shutdown reports an
error.

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`IOException`](../../io/IOException.md) | if TLS shutdown or TCP closure reports a failure |
